description: Understand what is data mining and what are key components of the data mining pipeline, including Introduction to Data mining Pipeline, Data understanding, Data understadining, Data Warehouse Architecture.

Learn and apply one of the basic core of data mining: data visualization, including Data visualization, Introduction of data visualization, Visualization of Numerical Data, Visualization of Non-Numerical Data, The Visualization of Dashboard.

Understand and apply pattern discovery as a data mining subfield, including frequent, closed, max, compressed, sequential, and vertical-format pattern mining, advanced pattern discovery issues such as data streams and privacy, and data visualization practice for data mining.

Apply cluster analysis as a data mining subfield, including similarity and distance measures, partitioning-based clustering, agglomerative and divisive hierarchical clustering, DBSCAN, multidimensional categorization, and clustering quality evaluation.
